lines.beaver_en: Did you hear about the new coworker?
lines.learner: 네, 지수 씨요? 다음 주부터 우리 팀에서 일한대요.
lines.en: Yes, Jisu? I heard she starts on our team next week.
lines.roman: ne, jisu ssiyo? daeum jubuteo uri timeseo ilhandaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: What kind of person is she? Is she nice?
lines.en: I heard she's kind-hearted and gets along well with people.

lines.beaver_en: What else did you hear about her personality?
lines.en: She's very sociable, so she makes friends fast, I hear.

lines.beaver_en: Really? Is she good at her work?
lines.en: Yes, she's clever, so she learns quickly, I hear.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, nice. Does she have any weak points?
lines.learner: 일할 때 좀 냉정하게 말하는 게 단점이래요.
lines.en: Her weak point is talking a bit coldly at work, they say.
lines.roman: ilhal ttae jom naengjeonghage malhaneun ge danjeomiraeyo.

lines.beaver: 일할 때는 그럴 수 있죠. 유머 감각은요?
lines.beaver_en: That happens at work. What about her sense of humor?
lines.beaver_roman: ilhal ttaeneun geureol su itjyo. yumeo gamgageunyo?
lines.learner: 유머도 있어서 회의 때 사람들을 자주 웃긴대요.
lines.en: She's funny too, and often makes people laugh in meetings.
lines.roman: yumeodo isseoseo hoeui ttae saramdeureul jaju utgindaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: I heard she's young. Will she be okay?
lines.learner: 어리지만 철이 들어서 실수를 잘 안 한대요.
lines.en: She's young but mature, so she rarely makes mistakes.
lines.roman: eorijiman cheori deureoseo silsureul jal an handaeyo.

lines.en: I heard it from Manager Kim. He praised her a lot.

lines.beaver_en: Then shall we have lunch with her on her first day?
lines.en: Sounds good. I heard Jisu likes Korean food too.
Thanks. I'll prepare a welcome card.
